name: Qubit Array Wafer
lore: Thousands of qubits, engraved through a metamaterial lens.
research: Femtoengineering - Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

name: Room-Temperature Superconductor
lore: Zero resistance without cryogenics. Physicists have chased this for a century.
research: Room-Temperature Superconductivity - Cooper pairs that hold together at room temperature, inside a hydrogen-rich framework.

name: Topological Circuit Board
lore: A board whose traces are protected by topology.
research: Assembly Lines - Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

name: Topological Logic Wafer
lore: Braided anyons on a wafer - errors cannot touch them.
research: Topological Matter - Phases of matter protected by topology rather than symmetry.

name: Topological Wafer
lore: A wafer whose edges carry current without resistance.
research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

name: Entanglement Tuner
lore: Links Entangled Transceivers to one channel. Sneak-use a transceiver to switch it between sending and receiving.

name: Gene Sampler
lore: Use on any creature to take a genome sample. Creatures from other dimensions give xenogenome samples.

name: Von Neumann Probe
lore: Builds copies of itself from whatever it finds. Put one in a Dyson Array.
research: Dyson Swarm - Millions of statites harvesting starlight.

name: Axiom Key
lore: Opens the breach to the space where laws are born. Use it to travel there and back.
research: The Axiomatic Breach - Break every law of physics and mathematics at once, and step through the hole. Unlocks the Axiomatic Breach Engine and the Axiom Key.

name: Reality Anchor
lore: Keeps a patch of reality from being edited.
research: The Simulation Hypothesis - If reality is computed, it can be decompiled - and edited.

name: Kugelblitz Seed
lore: Enough focused light to collapse on itself.
research: Singularity Physics - Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.

name: Primordial Harvest
lore: Every crop that has ever grown, in one seed.

name: Spark of Life
lore: The moment chemistry became biology, caught and kept.
research: Abiogenesis - Where chemistry becomes life. Unlocks the Abiogenesis Crucible and the Spark of Life.

name: Arrow of Time Shard
lore: Entropy only goes up - that is all "forward" means. This shard points the other way.
research: Temporal Mechanics - The arrow of time, and how to tie it in knots without causing a paradox. Unlocks the Chrono Loom.

name: Axiom Fragment
lore: A shard of a foundational rule. Mathematics is built on these; so is reality.
research: Hyperdimensional Reality - The space outside every universe, where universes grow on a tree and laws are born from an ocean.

name: Cardinal Shard
lore: A piece of how many there are - even when there are infinitely many.

name: Cosmic Record Fragment
lore: A sliver of a disc that recorded the Big Bang.

name: Horizon Shard
lore: A sliver of event horizon brought back out of a simulated universe. Everything that falls into it is remembered.
research: Horizon Simulation - A black hole is the densest possible computer. Feed it a star and it will simulate one. Unlocks the Eye of the Event Horizon.

name: Kaluza-Klein Shard
lore: Momentum around a fifth dimension curled up too small to see. Mined in the Bulk.
research: Brane Cosmology - Our universe is a membrane floating in the Bulk. The Brane Shifter can take you there.

name: Kerr Metric Shard
lore: The exact geometry around a spinning black hole - ergosphere and all.
research: General Relativity - Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

name: Magnetar Shard
lore: Its magnetic field would wipe a credit card from the Moon.
research: Traversable Wormholes - Black and white holes joined at the throat, propped open with negative mass.

name: Ordinal Shard
lore: A piece of the order in which infinities come.
research: The Transfinite Hierarchy - Ordinals count past infinity; cardinals measure it. Both have a place of their own - with the objects of higher dimensions. Unlocks the Cantor Key and the Ordinal Recursor.

name: Pentaquark Shard
lore: Five quarks bound into one exotic hadron. They only exist for an instant - unless you crystallise them.
research: Accelerator Physics - Bend a beam with dipoles, focus it with quadrupoles, push it with RF cavities - and keep it all at two kelvin in a perfect vacuum. Unlocks the beamline components and the Hyperion Synchrotron.

name: Prime Shard
lore: Divisible only by itself and one. Grows naturally in the Platonic Realm; otherwise it has to be sieved out.
research: Number Theory - Primes, modular forms and the Riemann zeta function - the hardest problems in mathematics are about whole numbers.

name: Proof Fragment
lore: Part of a proof an Axiom Sentinel was writing about you. QED.

name: Silicon Life Spore
lore: Life built on silicon instead of carbon. It grew in the Bulk.
research: Xenobiology - Life in other dimensions does not use DNA. Unlocks xenogenome work, Xenoplasm and silicon life.

name: Superpartner Shard
lore: A neutralino: the supersymmetric twin of a boson. It turns out to be what dark matter is made of.
research: Supersymmetry - Every boson has a fermion twin. The lightest of them is dark matter.

name: Void Lattice Shard
lore: A fragment of the scaffolding between branes.

name: Brane Shifter
lore: Slip sideways out of this brane and into the Bulk.

name: Cantor Key
lore: Opens the Transfinite Hierarchy, where every infinity has its own place. Use again to return.

name: Horizon Diver
lore: Crosses an event horizon - inward. Use again to come back out, which should be impossible.

name: Planck Diver
lore: Shrinks you past the Planck length into the Quantum Foam. Use again to come back.

name: Carbon Nanotube Bundle
lore: Graphene rolled into tubes, the tubes twisted into rope.
research: Nanochemistry - Carbon one atom thick, rolled, folded and caged. Unlocks graphene, nanotubes and buckyballs.

name: Penrose Spindle
lore: Couples to a rotating horizon's ergosphere.

name: Telomerase Complex
lore: Rebuilds the clocks at the ends of chromosomes. Cells that have it do not age.
research: Directed Evolution - A million generations in a minute, if time runs fast enough. Unlocks the Evolution Engine and telomerase.

name: Turbomolecular Rotor
lore: Bladed discs spinning at ninety thousand rpm, batting gas molecules out of the beamline one at a time.
research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

name: Grand Unified Core
lore: At high enough energy the strong, weak and electromagnetic forces are one force again.
research: Grand Unification - At high enough energy, three forces become one.

name: M-Theory Core
lore: Eleven dimensions, and all five string theories turn out to be one.
research: M-Theory - Strings are the edges of membranes in eleven dimensions.

name: Stellar Core
lore: A captive star the size of a fist, ignited by a white hole.
research: Plasma Metallurgy - Alloys forged in stellar plasma: Chronosteel and Exotic Solder. Unlocks the Stellar Plasma Crucible.

name: Tachyon Crystal
lore: Arrives before it was made.
research: Tachyonics - Hypothetical faster-than-light particles. Their imaginary mass makes them slow down as they gain energy.

name: Wave Packet
lore: A particle, written as a sum of waves - localised, but never exactly.
research: Quantum Field Theory - Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.

name: Brane Tension Fiber
lore: A thread pulled from the membrane a Brane Strider walks on.

name: Cosmic String Segment
lore: A one-dimensional defect from the early universe.
research: White Holes - The time-reverse of a black hole: a horizon nothing can enter.

name: Geodesic Thread
lore: The straightest possible line - through curved spacetime.
research: Inside a Black Hole - What is past the horizon - and, through an Einstein-Rosen bridge, what is past the white hole's. Unlocks the Horizon Diver and the Geodesic Anchor.

name: Nanite Swarm
lore: A billion machines the size of viruses. Hungry.
research: Molecular Nanotechnology - Assemblers that build anything atom by atom - including copies of themselves.

name: Xenobot Swarm
lore: Living machines made of cells, designed by an evolutionary algorithm.
research: Synthetic Biology - Write life instead of reading it. Unlocks synthetic cells, xenobots and stem cell cultures.

name: Hyperlattice Frame
lore: A scaffold folded through a fourth dimension, so a nine-by-nine assembly has room for its insides.
research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

name: Minkowski Lattice
lore: Space and time as one four-dimensional geometry, with light cones at every point.
research: Special Relativity - The speed of light is the same for everyone - so time and space cannot be. Unlocks the Tensor Calculus Engine.

name: Penteract Lattice
lore: A five-dimensional cube: 32 corners, 80 edges, 40 cells.
research: The Transfinite Hierarchy - Ordinals count past infinity; cardinals measure it. Both have a place of their own - with the objects of higher dimensions. Unlocks the Cantor Key and the Ordinal Recursor.

name: Tesseract Core
lore: A hypercube's 3D shadow, rotating through a direction you cannot point to.
research: Causality Violation - Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

name: Einstein-Rosen Core
lore: Both ends of a bridge between a black hole and a white hole, held in one hand.
research: Inside a Black Hole - What is past the horizon - and, through an Einstein-Rosen bridge, what is past the white hole's. Unlocks the Horizon Diver and the Geodesic Anchor.

name: Wormhole Throat
lore: The narrowest point of an Einstein-Rosen bridge, held open with exotic matter.
research: Causality Violation - Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

name: Bubble Universe
lore: An entire universe hanging from a branch of the World Tree, caught before it fell.
research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

name: Pocket Universe
lore: An entire cosmos, folded into a bubble you can hold. Please do not drop it.
research: Causality Violation - Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

name: Panspermia Seed
lore: Life packed to survive the trip between universes.
research: Panspermia - Life carried between worlds - and between universes. Unlocks panspermia seeds and the omnicellular genome.

name: Universe Seed
lore: A grain of false vacuum primed to inflate into a cosmos.
research: Cosmogenesis - False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.

name: Alcubierre Coil
lore: Contracts space ahead, expands it behind.
research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

name: Plasma Nozzle Tip
lore: A converging magnetic nozzle that accelerates plasma to a few percent of light speed.
research: Plasma Metallurgy - Alloys forged in stellar plasma: Chronosteel and Exotic Solder. Unlocks the Stellar Plasma Crucible.
